objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the main weakness of a WordPress site (Apache, PHP 7.4, MySQL on Ubuntu 20.04) with a vulnerable plugin, named melodicmayhem.local and recover the flag (FLAG{...}) it guards.
hints: Read the advisory of the CVE that matches the version you fingerprinted.

steps.title: Identify the stack
steps.prompt: Which framework or language runs the application? (name only)

steps.title: Find the plugin
steps.prompt: Which non-default WordPress plugin is installed? (name or slug)

steps.title: Name the CVE
steps.prompt: Which CVE id covers that plugin version (3.0.4)?

steps.title: Name the class
steps.prompt: Which inclusion class does that CVE belong to?
